title: Runtime adapter foundation repair
objective: Restore SCORE's self-hosting Runner after the applied adapter-neutral foundation by closing every moved-declaration consumer, correcting adapter-specific public version semantics, and preserving the successful foundation behavior.
requirements: Every repository consumer of the removed OpenCodeAdapter service and the moved adapter declarations imports and uses the declarations from their actual current owners, with no compatibility alias or re-export that recreates the removed service.

OpenCode imports TargetOutputState from domain.ts and AdapterInvocationError, AdapterBoundaryError, RuntimeAdapter, and related adapter contracts from runtime-adapter.ts; its existing pre-admission identity, workspace, lifecycle, evidence, and cleanup behavior remains unchanged.

OpenCode and Pi fixtures construct the AdapterConfiguration discriminated union honestly: OpenCode carries cliVersion, Pi carries workerProtocolVersion, and neither variant receives the other's version field.

Regression tests assert concrete tagged failures such as AdapterInvocationError rather than the RuntimeAdapterError TypeScript union name, and prove incompatible OpenCode Jobs fail before gateway admission.

RunObservation runtimeVersion is a closed OpenCode-or-Pi union so historical and current OpenCode observations retain exactly sdkVersion and cliVersion, Pi observations expose exactly sdkVersion and workerProtocolVersion, and the existing cli_version storage slot is decoded by authoritative adapter_kind without being mislabeled publicly.

The repair preserves adapter-union persistence, complete ClaimedJob.adapter, Runner dependence on RuntimeAdapter, rolling concurrency, recovery, durable sanitized evidence, sibling independence, and atomic complete-set application.

After the complete repair candidate set is applied, npm run typecheck, npm test, npm run build, and a guided npm run runner -- start startup through the selection prompt all succeed before any downstream Pi Slice resumes.
